summary: CTO Realty Growth, Inc. filed an 8-K to announce the addition of Cantor Fitzgerald and Huntington Securities as sales agents in its existing at-the-market preferred stock offering program for up to $25M of Series A Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock at $25/share liquidation preference. This is a routine capital markets update—appointing additional agents and amending existing equity distribution agreements—not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or management change is involved. The filing is an ordinary shelf takedown arrangement with no event-driven catalyst.
